query:
SELECT
            d.day::DATE           AS "date!: NaiveDate",
            COALESCE(rc.count, 0) AS "count!: i64"
        FROM generate_series(
            (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '34 days')::DATE,
            CURRENT_DATE,
            INTERVAL '1 day'
        ) AS d(day)
        LEFT JOIN daily_review_counts rc
            ON rc.review_date = d.day AND rc.user_id = $1
        ORDER BY d.day ASC
